title: P15.9-B2: /app/company Company Cockpit on canonical businessCompany read
description: B2 of approved P15.9-B0 plan (PR #92): /app/company renders the real Company Cockpit reading only GET /api/vnext/businesses/:id/company via useSelectedBusiness() — never enumerates /api/businesses, AbortController blocks stale-response overwrite, prior business data dropped on switch/failure. Dashboard: header, stat cards (owned/pending exact, breakdown + spend labeled over returned page), truncation banner, Needs Your Attention (fresh pending via latest_review.owner_action_required; global approvals labeled; HALT=API_MISSING no count), EntityCard grid (UNVERIFIED when canonically_proven=false; proven|claimed budget), Recent reviews labeled not-a-full-feed. Audit R1: money() always USD (microusd is USD; VND fixture proves $10.00 not '10 VND'); req() noAuthPrompt opt-out used by businessCompany AND a Company-only approvalsNoPrompt read — 401 on either shows credential-rejected/degraded state with no prompt/reload, legacy api.approvals prompt behavior unchanged (proven on /); truncation fixture contract-consistent (230 owned / 200 returned / objectives.length==200; proven=false case has met=0, unverified=total, all_targets_met=false); Schedules.tsx cast fixed so tsc clean. States: no-business/loading/401/403 Denied/FAIL_CLOSED integrity — never error-to-empty. Zero backend/authority change, zero new deps. Proof: cockpit+met-fold vitest unchanged-green; tsc PASS, vite build PASS, playwright 32/32 PASS (app 12 + company 10 + smoke 5 + chat 5) on real :8790 server.
